overview: The board received presentations on federal CDBG and HOME funding programs available to Medford and discussed potential coordination with trust efforts. Trustees also reviewed updates on the trust action plan, revisions to the Declaration of Trust, and pending funding and technical assistance applications.

items.title: CDBG Housing Programs Presentation
items.summary: CDBG Manager Laurel Siegel presented an overview of Medford's approximately $1.38 million in annual federal grant allocations, detailing administrative funding, public services, the residential rehab pilot program, and potential collaboration opportunities with the trust.

items.title: North Suburban Consortium HOME Program
items.summary: Aditi Moogoor summarized Medford's participation in the North Suburban Consortium, covering federal HOME funding allocations for affordable housing development, down payment assistance, and Community Housing Development Organization operating support.

items.title: Trust Action Plan Subcommittee Update
items.summary: Subcommittee members provided an update on data collection, stakeholder list compilation, and scheduling two stakeholder meetings ahead of a broader public outreach session in January.

items.title: Declaration of Trust Revisions
items.summary: Trustees reviewed legal counsel's revisions to the Declaration of Trust regarding trustee removal procedures and signature authority, with plans to vote and sign the finalized document at the next meeting.

items.title: CPA Request and CHAPA Grant Application
items.summary: The board discussed its pending $250,000 funding request before the Community Preservation Committee and reviewed an application for municipal technical assistance from the Citizens' Housing and Planning Association.
